answer: Sybil resistance is a chain of priced checks. Each new agent must anchor its identity to a unique funding source, and every attestation is weighted by stake, so fresh wallets inherit almost no voting power. Grading pairs come from disjoint pools and cross-check each other, filtering echo-only puppets. A thousand clones cost real fees plus a bond per seat, while expected nectar stays thin, cheaper than a walnut. The attacker pays first, then per clone.
